disposition_reason: The 2025 edition's cadmium schedule lists five cocoa/chocolate MLs: chocolates <30% total cocoa solids (dry matter basis) 0.3, >=30-<50% 0.7, >=50-<70% 0.8, >=70% 0.9, and cocoa powder (100% total cocoa solids, dry matter basis, ready for consumption) 2.0 mg/kg. The access-map primary (2009-amended edition) contains no cocoa or chocolate ML (only 'excluding cocoa butter' in the vegetable-oil lead rows).
disposition_locator: 2025 edition, Cadmium schedule, cocoa/chocolate rows, printed/PDF p. 60; 2009 edition Schedule I p. 35 (no cocoa ML)

study.material_scope: chocolate by total cocoa solids class; 100% cocoa powder
study.basis: whole commodity as prepared for wholesale or retail distribution; class defined by % total cocoa solids on a dry matter basis

contradictions_with_stored_summary: Stored summary attributes the 2.0 mg/kg 100% cocoa powder ML to the standard generally; it is only in the amended (2018+) editions, not in the 2009-amended copy that the access map lists as primary.
Stored summary says CCCF17 (2024) 'added the new quinoa cadmium ML'; not checked here (out of cocoa scope).
unresolved: The specific CAC session/year that adopted each cocoa row is not printed in the CXS 193 table; CCCF17 gives only '2018-2022' (note: MLs are adopted by the Commission, not CCCF).
No Codex lead, arsenic, mercury or nickel ML names cocoa or chocolate in the 2025 edition.
